focus_areas: Realism of eye reflection and iris detail
Consistency of fur direction and strand definition
Boundary sharpness between facial ruff and background
Anatomical correctness of the nose and mouth junction
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'uncanny valley' effect in the eyes. AI often generates eyes that are too perfect or have unnatural reflections. Also, scrutinize the transition zone between the bare facial skin and the fur; AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Check if the 'ruff' looks like attached hair or just a painted color gradient.
image_description: A close-up portrait of a guenon monkey, specifically appearing to be a Blue Monkey or similar species. The image focuses on the head and upper shoulders. The monkey has dark grey/blue fur with a lighter, whitish ruff around the chin and cheeks. The face is bare, dark-skinned, with expressive amber/brown eyes and a narrow nose. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/green blur.

To verify the integrity of the hair strands against the background and ensure no floating artifacts or blending errors exist.
